ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT ZONING LOT AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT made this 2 day of July, 2008, by and between Abraham Buxbaum, residing at 26 Heyard Street, Apt. 1R, Brooklyn, New York 11211 ("Grantor") and 373 Wythe Realty, Inc., a New York corporation, having an office at 25-15 50"h Street, Woodside, New York 11377 ("Grantee"). WITNESSETH: Grantee is the owner of certain land and the buildings and improvements thereon known by the street address 373 Wythe Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11211 (Section 3, Block 2442, Lot 1 on the Tax Map of the City of New York), more particularly described in Exhibit A . annexed hereto ("Grantee's Land"). by the street address 78 South 4 Street, Brooklyn, New York 11211 (Section 3, Block 2442, Lot 16 on the Tax Map of the City of New York),more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto ("Grantor's Land"). Grantee previously created a single zoning lot pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning ·Resolution of the City of New York as amended (the “Zoning Resolution"), consisting of the Grantee's Land and certain adjoining land (said single zoning lot being herein referred to as the "Existing Zoning Lot") and being more particularly described in Exhibit C annexed hereto.. The existing building and improvements located on Grantor's Land (the "Grantor's Building") do not utilize all of the development rights attributable to Grantor's Land under the between Grantor and Grantee, dated June 26, 2008 (the “Purchase _Agreement"), Grantor agreed to sell and transfer to Grantee all of excess floor area development rights attributable to the zoning lot comprising Grantor's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (the “Excess Development Rights").It is estimated that there are approximately 3,748 square feet of Excess Development Rights. Grantee desires to construct a new residential building (the “New Building") on Grantee's Land that will inciude more floor area than is currently allowed for the Existing ZoningLotpursuant totheZoningResolution. Grantee has the right to utilize the Excess Development Rights which were acquired by Grantee from Grantor pursuant to a certain Excess Development Rights Purchase Agreement by Grantee,Grantor has agreed torestrict its ability to alter,expand,repair or demolish Grantor's Building. By Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated the date hereof (the “Declaration"), Grantor and Grantee have declared that the Existing Zoning Lot and the zoning lot comprising Grantor's Land are to be treated as one zoning lot for the purpose of and in accordance with the provisions of the Zoning Resolution (the “Expanded Zoning Lot"), thereby permitting the AA/86001.4

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promises contained herein, Grantor and Grantee, with intent to bind themselves, their successors and assigns, do hereby agree as follows: 1.(a)  Grantor does hereby grant and release unto Grantee and its heirs, successors and assigns forever, a perpetual easement for light and air over, above and around Grantor's Building, and hereby covenants and agrees that no new buildings or additions shall be constructed or allowed to exist on Grantor's Land, and no reconstruction, enlargement, repair or rebuilding of Grantor's Building shall be made: (i)  at a height greater than the top of the present height of the highest plane of the roof of Grantor's Building as it exists as of the date hereof (except for replacement of any installations such as water tanks, chimneys, elevator shaft, antenna or stairwells that are now in place, with similar installations); (ii)having a floor area on the ground floor level (the “Footprint Area"), in excess of the Footprint Area of Grantor's Building as it exists as of the date hereof; and (i) having a total floor area in excess of the total floor area of Grantor's Building as it exists as of the date hereof. (b)The easements and covenants set forth in this Paragraph shall burden Grantor's Land for the benefit of Grantee's Land, and shall run with the land. Rights and agrees that Grantee shall have the right to incorporate into the New Building all or any portion of the Excess Development Rights in order to enlarge the permissible height, bulk and floor area of the New Building and Grantor hereby grants to Grantee a perpetual easement for said purpose. Grantor shall retain all rights to the floor area of Grantor's Building existing as of the date hereof and Grantee shall not have any rights thereto. (b) The New Building shall not encroach upon Grantor's Land or the air space above Grantor's Land and/or Grantor's Building. 3. Grantor hereby represents and warrants as follows: (a) it has not previously transferred, assigned or encumbered the Excess encumbered in accordance with any mortgages of record as of the date hereof, (b) it is seized of Grantor's Land in fee simple and has the right to convey the Excess Development Rights, (c) all “parties in interest" (as such term is used in paragraph (d) and defined in paragraph (f) in the definition of “zoning lot” set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution) with respect to Grantor's Land have waived their respective rights in connection with the Excess Development Rights so as to facilitate the conveyance of the Excess Development Rights from Grantor to Grantee.
